To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
phagosome maturing in p110α deficient THP-1 monocytic cells is blocked at the stage of acquisition of Rab7.

phagosomes from class IA PI3 kinase p110α deficient THP-1 human monocytic cells are defective in lysosomal protein delivery, but contain normal levels of Rab-interacting proteins and components of the homotypic vacoule fusion and protein sorting complex.
class IA PI3-kinase p110α is required for phagosome matuation beyond Rab7 acquisition to the delivery of lysosmal markers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of phagosome formation and maturation.
the regulation of phagosome function and maturation.
the molecular mechanisms of phagocytosis, a process by which cells internalize particles and microorganisms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
class I PI3 kinases are essential for the delivery of lysosomes to maturing phagosomes, and that class I PI(3,5) kinases are not required for phagosomal maturation.
p110α is essential for phagosome maturing to the lysosome.
class IA PI3 kinase is necessary and sufficient to promote phagosome maturing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
class IA PI3Kinase p110α regulates phagosome maturing through a mechanism involving delivery of lysosomal hydrosolases to the phagosomes.
class IA PI3 kinase p110α is necessary for the delivery of lysosomes to the maturing phagosome.
the phagosome maturing process is regulated by both class III PI3K and class IA PI3 kinase, p110α.
The main takeaway from our work is that
class III PI3K is not the only class of PI3K that regulates phagosomal maturation.
phagosomes from cells lacking p110α are deficient in lysosome fusion, which is a novel role for a class I PI 3 kinase.
class Ia PI3K p1010α regulates phagosome maturing to deliver lysosomal proteins, but is not required for the recruitment of Rab7 or other components involved in fusion of phagosomes with lysosomes.
